title: libimage: make unsupported transport errors actionable
body:
`docker://...` refers to an image in a remote registry, whereas `LookupImage` searches local storage, so the existing error doesn't explain how to resolve the problem. Include the offending reference in the error and suggest using a local image name or pulling the image first. Add TestLookupImageUnsupportedTransport covering `docker://` and `docker-daemon:` references.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/20775

comments.body: Yes this is an improvement, thanks.

/packit rebuild-failed

The rpm-build jobs for centos-stream-10, fedora-43 and fedora-eln failed, while centos-stream-9, fedora-44, fedora-45 and rawhide passed. This PR only changes the error message in `common/libimage/runtime.go`, and the Copr build pages are no longer available, so this looks like a transient build failure. Re-running the failed jobs.

Thanks @mtrmac, @danishprakash. I went with not offering a replacement name, since we can't tell whether the user meant a local image or a remote one. The error now keeps the transport and names the rejected reference:

`unsupported transport "docker" for looking up local images: "docker://quay.io/foo/bar" is not a local image name`

I also squashed the two commits into one, so the history matches the final change. The earlier test was already removed.
